migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS client_meeting (
  id                TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  patient_id        TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind              TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'session',
  status            TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
  modality          TEXT,
  starts_at         INTEGER NOT NULL,
  ends_at           INTEGER,
  source_origin     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'app',
  sync_state        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'local',
  provider_id       TEXT,
  provider_event_id TEXT,
  calendar_id       TEXT,
  created_at        INTEGER NOT NULL,
  updated_at        INTEGER NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meeting_patient  ON client_meeting(patient_id, starts_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meeting_upcoming ON client_meeting(starts_at);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_meeting_provider ON client_meeting(provider_id, provider_event_id);
